classification.difficultyReason: Use the preceding comparisons to justify overall class performance, weighing Class A's higher typical marks against Class B's higher individual maximum.

content.prompt: Students in two classes sat the same mathematics test. Their results are shown in the two boxplots below.

spec.description: Unfilled horizontal boxplots on a common scale, Class A above Class B; whiskers have no end caps. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: Common labelled scale 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. Class A graphical positions approximately minimum 14.5, Q1 30, median 35, Q3 40, maximum 44.5. Class B approximately minimum 10, Q1 25.5, median 33.5, Q3 37.5, maximum 50. Approximate coordinates reproduce graphical relationships and are not additional printed numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: All boxplots and labels are permanent question givens; no answer annotations.

inlines.text: Which class had the higher median mark?

answer.worked: Class A's median line is farther to the right on the common scale, so its median mark is higher.

inlines.text: Which class had the higher interquartile range?

answer.worked: The interquartile range is the distance from the lower quartile to the upper quartile. Class B has the wider box on the common scale, so its interquartile range is higher.

inlines.text: In which class was the highest mark for the test obtained?

answer.worked: Class B's right whisker ends farther to the right, so Class B has the higher maximum mark.

inlines.text: In which class was the lowest mark for the test obtained?

answer.worked: Class B's left whisker ends farther to the left, so Class B has the lower minimum mark.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Which class did better on the test? Give reasons for your choice. (Class discussion)

answer.short: Class A: its minimum, lower quartile, median and upper quartile are all higher. Only its maximum is lower.
answer.worked: Class A did better overall: its minimum, lower quartile, median and upper quartile are all higher than Class B's. Its higher median indicates a higher typical mark. Class B obtained the highest individual mark, but this alone does not show better overall performance.
